sn3.14:1.2: This was obviously after Ajātasattu’s regicide of his father Bimbisāra, and must therefore be in the last years of the Buddha’s life. It is just one of the indications of Ajātasattu’s aggressive nature and the breakdown of peace in the Buddha’s final years. | Kāsi, of which Varanasi was the capital, had lost its status as an independent kingdom to Pasenadi’s father. Here it has become the proxy for the struggle for dominance between the two largest kingdoms of the time, Kosala and Magadha, a struggle that Magadha would ultimately win.
